name: Steal A Car
desc:
🚗 Welcome to Steal a Car!

How to Play:
🚗 Steal cars to build your collection
🚓 Outrun the police and escape with your car
💰 Earn money from your cars
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal cars from other players
✨ Discover rarer and cooler cars!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet
